text: MDM- Intelligent Mobile Robotics INITIAL PHASE PROJECT DOCUMENT: INSTRUCTIONS Students are required to prepare an Initial Phase Project Document explaining their project idea, the problem they want to solve, the proposed solution, and how they plan to develop the project. 1.​ Project Title ●​ Mention the title of your project. ●​ The title should be short, clear, and related to your project. 2.​ Project Area ●​ Mention the main area/domain of your project. ●​ Examples: Robotics, IoT, AI, Machine Learning, Web Development, App Development, Networking, Automation, etc. 3.​ Problem Definition ●​ Explain the problem that your project aims to solve.

MDM- Intelligent Mobile Robotics DOCUMENT FORMATTING GUIDELINES The document must follow these formatting rules: 1.​ Font: Times New Roman 2.​ Font Size: 12 3.​ Line Spacing: 1.15 4.​ Text Alignment: Justified 5.​ Numbering: Use proper numbering for sections and sub-sections. 6.​ Tables: Add tables wherever required. 7.​ Images: Add relevant images wherever required. 8.​ Flowcharts: Add flowcharts wherever required to explain the working/process. 9.​ Diagrams: Add block diagrams, circuit diagrams, architecture diagrams, etc., wherever applicable. 10.​Captions: Give proper names/numbers to tables, images, and diagrams. 11.​Content: Keep the information clear, relevant, and related to your project.
